TcProperty.description: This attribute stores the user selected action.
Represents the context in which parts are aligned to design.
This property shows the release status for the aligned part.
Represents the list of parts aligned to design
pma1AlignToGenericPart is a boolean property which represents pma0AligntoGenericPart property on Pma0DesignAttr. Default value is False.
Represents if the part is aligned with design
pma1IsPartRequired is a boolean property which represents if the Design requires a Part. Default value is NULL.
This property corresponds to the Last Aligned Part to the Design.
Property Created to map the property pma1IsStandard defined on type BOMLine
Represents the context in which designs are aligned to part.
This property shows the release status for the aligned design.
Represents the designs aligned to the part.
Represents if the design is aligned with part.
pma1IsDesignRequired is a boolean property which represents if the Part requires a Design. Default value is NULL.
This property corresponds to the Last Aligned Design to the Part.
pma1LessFinish is a string property. It Indicates if the Part is a Less Finish Part or Colored Part. The valid values are 1. Less Finish 2. Colored Part 3. None The default value is None.
pma1MultiBody is a Boolean property. Multibody part Indicates if Piece Part is made up of multiple materials. The default value is False.
pma1SafetyPart is a boolean property. Safety Part indicates if Part is safety critical. A Safety Critical Part needs a set of approvals. The default value is False.
pma1SparePart is a Boolean property. Spare Part indicates if the part is available as a spare. The default value is True.

pma1TechnologyIntent is a string property. Technology Intent indicates the intent if the Part is to be designed In-House or the Design will be contracted. The valid values are 1. In-house Design 2. Design Outsourced 3. Design Purchased 4. Un-assigned The default value is In-house Design.

ServiceInterface.description:
The GenerateBOM service interface exposes the operations that enable generation of a type of BOM structure from another source structure type. For instance, generating an Engineering BOM from Design BOM and vice-versa.

Acronyms used:
    • BOM                Bill of material.
    • CBA                CAD-BOM alignment.
    • CBA Page        The Active workspace UI containing the engineering BOM and design BOM structures alongside each other.

OperationTemplate.description:
This asynchronous operation generates engineering BOM structure from source design BOM structure and aligns them. The operation identifies the source BOM structure type and generates relevant type of target BOM structure. Target BOM occurrences are created for the source BOM occurrences specified in the input. When the input source BOM occurrence is a sub-assembly (has structure beneath), the target BOM occurrence is generated for the whole sub-assembly. Multiple source BOM occurrences in the input should be siblings to each other. These newly generated target BOM occurrences are placed under the target BOM occurrence specified in the input. The source and target nodes must contain valid BOMLine objects.
Supported source and target type combination is as follows:
Source Type Target Type
Design BOM Engineering BOM
Engineering BOM Design BOM

Void. Since this is an asynchronous operation, there is no return value. In case of success, the user will be notified through a success message in the alerts section. In case of failure due to any of the following partial errors, the user will be notified through a message in the alerts section.
• 427005 sourceOccurrences do not belong to same parent.
• 427006 sourceOccurrences contain more than 1 elements when no targetOccurrence is specified.
• 427007 The given sourceOccurrence is not a valid Design or Part.
• 427008 The given targetOccurrence is not a valid Design or Part.
• 427009 The given combination of source and target is not supported.

Operation.useCase:
• Use case 1:
Design structure and engineering BOM structure is opened in CBA page. User selects
some design BOM occurrences and drags them on the target engineering BOM occurrence. This operation will create engineering BOM occurrences for the complete structure beneath the selected design BOM occurrences and place them under the target engineering BOM occurrence.

• Use case 2:
Engineering BOM structure and Design structure is opened in CBA page. User selects
some engineering BOM occurrences and drags them on the target design BOM occurrence. This operation will create design BOM occurrences for the complete structure beneath the selected engineering BOM occurrences and place them under target design BOM occurrence.

• Use case 3:
User selects the top occurrence of a BOM structure and invokes "Generate BOM" operation. This operation will then create target BOM structure for the complete input BOM structure. For example, for the input design BOM structure, complete engineering BOM structure is created and vice-versa.
